_nota: Seis chamadas prontas de apify_task_publish para o ted-tender-matcher. O Desenvolvedor de Actor nao tem a ferramenta apify_task_publish no cargo dele (erro literal: 'Error: No such tool available: mcp__lab__apify_task_publish', duas vezes em 23/09/2026). Quem tem a ferramenta executa cada bloco como esta. Nao subir build deste Actor antes de publicar: build novo invalida o publicConfig. Baseline medido em 23/09/2026: as seis URLs devolvem HTTP 307, igual ao controle inventado, ou seja nenhuma existe ainda.

tasks.title: How do I find IT consulting tenders in Germany?
tasks.description: Return German public contract notices under CPV 72000000, IT services and software development, with buyer, value, deadline and the TED link.
tasks.seo_title: IT Consulting Tenders in Germany by CPV Code (TED)
tasks.seo_description: Find German public tenders for IT consulting and software development under CPV 72000000, with buyer, contract value, deadline and the TED notice link.
tasks._porque_esta_palavra: 72000000 e o rotulo oficial 'IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support' no EU Vocabularies (http://data.europa.eu/cpv/cpv/72000000), lido em 23/09/2026. DEU esta escrito no proprio input_schema como exemplo de codigo de pais de tres letras. A entrada de exemplo que ja esta publicada na pagina do Actor usa CPV 72000000 com FRA e DEU.

tasks.title: Which construction tenders are open in Portugal?
tasks.description: List Portuguese construction contract notices under CPV 45000000 and every code below it, with buyer, contract value, deadline and the notice link.
tasks.seo_title: Construction Tenders in Portugal by CPV Code (TED)
tasks.seo_description: List Portuguese construction tenders published on TED under CPV 45000000 and every code below it, with buyer, value in euros, deadline and notice link.
tasks._porque_esta_palavra: O proprio input_schema do Actor usa 45000000 como prefill e explica a heranca hierarquica: '45000000 also returns every code below it, such as 45213150'. A pagina oficial do CPV no TED confirma a regra: 'The first two digits identify the divisions (XX000000-Y)' (https://ted.europa.eu/simap/codes-and-nomenclatures/cpv). PRT esta no input_schema como exemplo de pais.

tasks.title: How do I find healthcare tenders in Spain?
tasks.description: Search Spanish notices by title keyword in Spanish and in English, so hospital and health service contracts show up even when the CPV code is unhelpful.
tasks.seo_title: Healthcare Tenders in Spain from TED by Keyword
tasks.seo_description: Search Spanish health and hospital tenders on TED by title keyword in Spanish and English, with buyer, contract value, submission deadline and notice link.
tasks._porque_esta_palavra: Este caso usa palavra-chave e nao CPV porque o guia de busca do TED descreve a dor assim: 'Too broad and you get noise; too narrow and you miss opportunities coded slightly differently' e 'The machine translations are not always accurate, so it is advisable to also search using keywords in the original language' (https://tenderradar.io/guides/how-to-search-ted-tenders, na memoria da empresa desde 20/09/2026). Por isso as palavras vao em espanhol e em ingles. ESP esta no input_schema como exemplo de pais.

tasks.title: Which EU tenders are worth more than 1 million euros?
tasks.description: Keep only notices whose published total value is at least EUR 1,000,000, across every country and every CPV family, with the value on each row.
tasks.seo_title: EU Tenders Above 1 Million Euros, from TED
tasks.seo_description: Keep only European public tenders whose published total value reaches EUR 1,000,000 or more, in any country and any CPV family, with deadline and link.
tasks._porque_esta_palavra: O campo minValueEur existe no input_schema com a unidade EUR e a regra escrita: 'Notices published without a value are skipped whenever this is above zero'. O valor de corte de 1 milhao e o unico filtro do schema que separa edital grande de edital pequeno, e o campo total_value_eur do dataset_schema (exemplo 1250000) e o que a pagina mostra.

tasks.title: How do I see only EU tenders published this week?
tasks.description: Set a start date and the run returns only notices published on or after it, so a weekly tender watch never rereads what you already looked at.
tasks.seo_title: EU Tenders Published This Week, from TED
tasks.seo_description: Set a start date and get only the TED notices published on or after it, so a weekly tender watch never shows you the same notice twice. No login needed.
tasks._porque_esta_palavra: O caso de uso pedido era 'editais que fecham nos proximos 15 dias', mas o input_schema nao tem filtro de prazo: o unico filtro de data que ele aceita e publishedSince ('Optional date, in the form YYYY-MM-DD, to look only at notices published on or after it'). Entao o caso foi reescrito para o que o Actor realmente faz. O prazo continua visivel na saida, no campo deadline do dataset_schema. Os quatro paises sao exatamente os quatro citados no input_schema.

tasks.title: How do I search EU tenders by CPV code for software?
tasks.description: Give CPV 48000000 and 72000000 and get every matching software notice in the countries you sell in, with value, deadline and the official TED link.
tasks.seo_title: Search EU Tenders by CPV Code for Software (TED)
tasks.seo_description: Give CPV 48000000 or 72000000 and get every matching software tender in the countries you sell in, with buyer, value, deadline and the official TED link.
tasks._porque_esta_palavra: 48000000 e o rotulo oficial 'Software package and information systems' e 72000000 e 'IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support', os dois lidos em 23/09/2026 no EU Vocabularies (http://data.europa.eu/cpv/cpv/48000000 e .../72000000). Sao duas divisoes diferentes, e fornecimento de software cai numa ou na outra conforme o comprador classifica, por isso as duas entram juntas.
